query:
INSERT INTO pins (
            id,
            cache_id,
            name,
            keep_kind,
            keep_value,
            current_revision
        )
        VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6)
        ON CONFLICT (cache_id, name) DO UPDATE
        SET keep_kind = EXCLUDED.keep_kind,
            keep_value = EXCLUDED.keep_value,
            current_revision = EXCLUDED.current_revision
